name: Avatar: The Last Airbender / The Legend of Korra
setting: a world of four nations inspired by East and South Asian and Inuit cultures
tone: warm, funny and earnest, with real darkness around war and trauma

name: Grey's Anatomy
setting: a Seattle teaching hospital
tone: emotional, romantic, often heartbreaking, with dark humour

name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer / Angel
setting: a small California town on a Hellmouth, later Los Angeles
tone: witty and self-aware, monsters as metaphors for growing up

name: Game of Thrones
setting: a medieval-style continent of rival noble houses
tone: brutal, morally grey, high stakes; frequent violence and deaths

name: Naruto / Naruto Shippuden
setting: ninja villages in a fantasy world
tone: energetic and emotional; themes of loneliness, rivalry, perseverance

name: Doctor Who (2005 revival)
setting: anywhere in time and space, starting from ordinary British homes
tone: whimsical, warm and sometimes devastating; about ordinary people discovering they matter

name: The Walking Dead
setting: the American South after society collapses
tone: bleak, tense and violent, about who you become when the rules are gone

name: Breaking Bad / Better Call Saul
setting: Albuquerque, New Mexico
tone: slow-burning, tense, morally dark, darkly funny

name: Stranger Things
setting: a small Indiana town in the 1980s
tone: nostalgic, scary and heartfelt; friendship against the dark

name: The Office (US)
setting: a paper company branch office in Scranton, Pennsylvania
tone: cringe comedy with a big heart

name: Friends
setting: a group of friends in their twenties in Manhattan
tone: light, warm and comforting

name: Attack on Titan
setting: a walled city besieged by giants, later a wider world at war
tone: intense, tragic, morally complex

name: My Hero Academia
setting: a hero academy in a world where most people have superpowers
tone: earnest, energetic and hopeful; about earning your place

name: Squid Game
setting: deadly children's games played by people drowning in debt
tone: tense, violent and heartbreaking; a critique of inequality

name: Ted Lasso
setting: a struggling London football club
tone: kind, funny and emotionally honest; mental health handled with care

name: Schitt's Creek
setting: a tiny rural town where a rich family lands after losing everything
tone: gentle, witty and warm; a slow turn from snobbery to love

name: BoJack Horseman
setting: Hollywood, in a world of humans and anthropomorphic animals
tone: absurd and funny on the surface, unflinching about depression and addiction

name: Money Heist (La casa de papel)
setting: a crew of outsiders pulling off huge heists in Madrid
tone: fast, stylish, emotional, with found-family loyalty

name: Mad Men
setting: a Madison Avenue advertising agency in 1960s New York
tone: slow, stylish and melancholy; about reinvention and the cost of success

name: Succession
setting: a billionaire media family fighting over who will inherit the company
tone: sharp, cruel and very funny; about love, power and never being enough

name: Parks and Recreation
setting: a small-town parks department in Pawnee, Indiana
tone: warm, optimistic and silly; friendship and public service

name: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
setting: a New York police precinct
tone: fast, goofy and kind; found family at work

name: Gilmore Girls
setting: a quirky small town in Connecticut
tone: cosy, witty and fast-talking; mothers, daughters and ambition

name: The Good Place
setting: a colourful afterlife neighbourhood
tone: clever, playful and big-hearted; what it means to be a good person

name: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
setting: an industrial-age country where alchemy is a science
tone: adventurous and funny, with deep grief, guilt and war

name: Arcane
setting: a gleaming city and the poor undercity beneath it
tone: gorgeous, tense and tragic; sisters on opposite sides

name: Dark
setting: a small German town where a child's disappearance exposes connected family secrets
tone: bleak, intricate and haunting; grief and fate

name: Sex Education
setting: a British secondary school where a sex therapist's son starts an advice clinic
tone: frank, funny and tender; identity, intimacy and growing up
